card.name: Plural verb after "such signs or symptoms"
card.fires_on: The plural verb "are" right after "If such signs or symptoms" in hypersensitivity warnings. It also fires weakly on a plural subject noun like "sufferers" after "migraine".

modes.label: Hypersensitivity warning
modes.description: The word "are" after "If such signs or symptoms", just before "present" and an instruction to stop the drug.
modes.example: If such signs or symptoms<< are>> present, discontinue celecoxib and

modes.label: Group noun after condition
modes.description: A plural noun naming people with a condition, in a news-style sentence.
modes.example: the foggy feeling migraine<< sufferers>> report is not just due to the pain

card.plain: It marks the verb "are" in the standard warning about signs of hypersensitivity, such as fever or swollen glands, that tells the reader to stop the drug.
